features.outline_preview: non-destructive white emissive curve copies parented to native outline objects
features.scanline_stage: post-process compositor overlay after the existing Composite image source
features.restoration: remove preview restores prior Composite image input and prior compositor enable state

fidelity_boundary: Native _E geometry is evidence-backed; Blender curve thickness and scanline presentation are host-side preview controls, not claimed exact Xenos/RSX rasterization or final scanout.
